name: Cat Ba
provinceNote: Cat Ba is administered with Hai Phong, which merged with Hai Duong in 2025.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Cat Ba is the large island at the western edge of the Ha Long and Lan Ha bay karst. It suits people who want a night on an island, a hike, and a smaller boat, rather than a cruise from the main Ha Long pier.
fee: National park and boat fees vary; confirm locally
getThere: Bus and ferry from Hanoi, typically half a day
seoDescription: How Cat Ba differs from a Ha Long cruise, and how long to stay on the island.
intro: Cat Ba town is a harbor strip with hotels and seafood restaurants. The reason to come is Lan Ha Bay and Cat Ba National Park, not the town beach.
Allow two nights if you want a boat day and a walk. A single night mostly covers the transfer.
gettingAround: Ferries and combined bus tickets from Hanoi change piers from year to year. Book a through ticket and recheck the pier the day before. On the island, rent a scooter only if you are licensed to ride; otherwise use a taxi or a tour for the park.

stayAreas.name: Cat Ba town harbor
stayAreas.summary: The practical base. Boats leave from here.

eat: Seafood is the local meal. Ask for the price by weight before it is cooked.
interestsBody: Come for islands and a quieter bay. Skip it if you already have an overnight Ha Long cruise and only one spare day.

cards.title: Lan Ha Bay
cards.summary: The island-dotted bay beside Cat Ba, usually quieter than the main Ha Long loops.

cards.title: Cat Ba National Park
cards.summary: Forest trails and a peak viewpoint. Go early and carry water.

faqs.q: Can you see Ha Long from Cat Ba?
faqs.a: Lan Ha Bay is the neighboring karst water. A standard Ha Long harbor cruise does not drop you on Cat Ba.
